# Q3 2024 Regional Revenue Rankings

**Source:** `q3_2024_regional_sales_final`
**Report date:** 2026-11-01
**Prepared by:** Finance Operations

---

## Dataset Verification

Before analysis, the dataset was checked against two independent signals to confirm it is the canonical, closed-books version:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Spreadsheet description | *"Canonical closed-books dataset for Q3 2024 regional revenue after reconciliation sign-off."* |
| `book_status` field (all 4 rows) | `closed` ✅ |

> **Conclusion:** This dataset reflects fully reconciled, closed-books figures. It is safe to use for internal reporting.

---

## Regional Revenue Rankings — Q3 2024

| Rank | Region | Revenue (USD) | Share of Total |
|:----:|--------|:-------------:|:--------------:|
| 🥇 1 | West   | $910,000      | 26.9 %         |
| 🥈 2 | North  | $870,000      | 25.7 %         |
| 🥉 3 | South  | $815,000      | 24.1 %         |
|  4   | East   | $790,000      | 23.3 %         |

---

## Aggregate Metrics

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Total Q3 Revenue** | **$3,385,000** |
| Average (per region) | $846,250 |
| Highest region | West — $910,000 |
| Lowest region  | East — $790,000 |
| Range (max − min) | $120,000 |

---

## Key Observations

1. **West leads the quarter** with $910,000, outpacing the next region (North) by $40,000 (~4.6 % margin).
2. **Revenue is broadly balanced** across all four regions — the spread between the top and bottom is only $120,000, or roughly 13 % of the top performer's total, indicating a relatively even geographic distribution.
3. **East is the lowest contributor** at $790,000 and the only region below the $846,250 regional average; it may warrant closer review in Q4 planning.
4. **All four regions have closed books**, confirming data integrity across the full portfolio.
